label: Sky City
history: The first permanent elevation doctrine was written here after repeated lowland collapses during geoidal surges.

artifact.name: Stormglass Survey Prism
artifact.note: Used to triangulate safe ascent windows when mist columns hide ridge edges.

label: The Weep
history: Sentences once ended at the waterfall edge. Igzier's survival rewrote exile doctrine and city fear.

artifact.name: Rim Hook Brace
artifact.note: A bent ascent hook found near the plunge shelf where condemned climbers vanished.

label: The Ledge
history: Where tide and stone negotiate each hour. Scouts learned to read predator wakes against the wall shadow.

artifact.name: Saltline Route Tablet
artifact.note: Marks narrow crossing windows between surge pulses and hunting swarms.

label: Silurian Riverlands
history: Sky City traded on denial while Silurian settlements watched every channel, seen and unseen.

artifact.name: Kel's Flood Marker
artifact.note: A movable depth glyph used to map ambush currents through reed canyons.

label: Mystic Woods (Asphodel)
history: Root Whisperer circles converted toxin-heavy fungal belts into controlled pharmacology corridors.

artifact.name: Lye-Washed Sclerotium Case
artifact.note: Carries processed clotting compounds and thermal-safe dosage slips.

label: Ironwoods (Tartarus)
history: Defensive growth shifted from manpower scaling to armored automation and corridor chokepoint engineering.

artifact.name: Ironback Laminar Plate
artifact.note: Patterned after sturgeon scute geometry for high-impact shelling zones.

label: Purgess Flats
history: The west flats became a pressure valve for ash and panic as Watcher cycles intensified.

artifact.name: Basalt Drift Compass
artifact.note: Needle oscillates with charged ash plumes, warning caravans of unstable air.

label: Watcher Volcano
history: When the cone stirs, every map lies. Stryker flights logged plume vectors instead of borders.

artifact.name: Stryker Wing Ledger
artifact.note: Heat-scored route cards from emergency flyovers over the crater throat.

label: Arnn Ridge
history: Ridge camps linked inland factions after exile routes collapsed, binding Sae's coalition by necessity.

artifact.name: Ironwood Oath Spike
artifact.note: Driven into ridge granite at pact-signing; still stained with seal resin.

label: Northern Mountains
history: High passes culled weak planning. Only crews with memory maps and ration discipline crossed alive.

artifact.name: Rimeproof Satchel Lining
artifact.note: Insulated weave that protected knot-codes during freeze winds.

label: Dier Lake
history: The eastern lake reflected storm fronts hours before impact, making it a strategic warning basin.

artifact.name: Mirrorwake Pole
artifact.note: Lake-skin probe for reading vibration signatures of large aquatic predators.

label: Straits of Dier
history: Neutral transit charters were negotiated here to preserve courier movement through predator-heavy channels.

artifact.name: Matsu-Knot Transit Sleeve
artifact.note: Encodes route class, urgency, and hand-to-hand restrictions for open-water relays.

label: Twin Straits of Dier
history: The Danian split around Pteros turned one passage into two lethal choices, each with different luck.

artifact.name: Dual Current Knotline
artifact.note: Two-strand knot language for signaling safe branch choice under pursuit.

label: Danian River
history: Jairo and Kel held close to city influence here while Igzier's inland arc bent toward reunion.

artifact.name: Riverfork Dead-Reckoner
artifact.note: Bone-scribed current wheel used to estimate split times before channel divergence.

label: Danian Delta
history: At Glow Tide the ash began to fall, the Watcher woke, and every political lie in Sky City came due.

artifact.name: Glow-Ash Filter Veil
artifact.note: Worn by delta crews during the first ash rain while extraction routes collapsed.

label: Pteros Island
history: The island became a logistics hinge where aerial relay ethics were codified across rival settlements and where a hybrid escape changed the city's balance of fear.

artifact.name: Resin-Sealed Reed Tube
artifact.note: Windproof message carrier with horn-stamp verification scar.
